exposure: Mode of conception (spontaneous vs. assisted reproductive technology)
outcome: Rate of small for gestational age neonates
Admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 1135 twin pregnancies (369 spontaneous, 766 assisted reproductive technology)
finding: Pregnancy outcomes were comparable between assisted reproductive technology-conceived and spontaneously conceived twins, with only the risk for gestational hypertension and preeclampsia remaining elevated in the assisted reproductive technology group after adjusting for confounding factors.
mod_finding: Dichorionic twins conceived by assisted reproductive technology had an earlier gestational age at delivery and more cesarean deliveries compared to spontaneously conceived dichorionic twins.
